senses.gloss: अशक्त a. unable to or incapable of (inf., loc., or dat.).

असक्त a. not hanging on or entangled in (loc.);
independent, free.
अशक्ति f. inability.
असक्ति f. non-attachment (to worldly things).
अशक्नुवन्त् a. not being able.

अशक्य a. impossible to or to be (inf.), impracticable.
Abstr. ˚ता f., ˚त्व n.
अशङ्कनीय a. not to be feared or supposed.
आशङ्कनीय a. to be feared.
अशठ a. not deceitful, honest.
अ॑शन् m. stone, rock, sky.
अस॑न् n. blood.
आस॑न् n. mouth, jaws.
अ॑शन n. eating, food.

अ॑सन n. throwing, hurling;
 f. असना॑ dart, arrow.
अशनानशन॑ n. eating and fasting.
अशनाया॑ f. hunger.
अशना॑या f. hunger.

अश॑नि f. (m.) thunderbolt, flash of lightning.

अ॑शब्द a. soundless;
 unvedic.

अ॑शम् (indecl.) ill luck;
 woe.
अशम m. restlessness.
1 असम a. unlike, uneven.
2 अ॑सम a. having no equal, incomparable.
अश॑स् a. cursing, hating, foe.
आश॑स् f. wish, expectation, hope.
अशस्त्र a. unarmed.
अशस्त्रपूत a. not purified by the sword.
अशान्त a. unsubdued, ˚मानस u. in mind.

अ॑ससन्त् a. sleepless.

अशास्त्रविहित a. not enjoined by the precept books,

अ॑षाढ a. unconquerable;

आषाढ m. a cert. mouth.

अ॑षाळ्ह a. unconquerable;

अ॑संयत a. unrestrained, uncontrolled.

असंयतात्मन्^1 a. having the soul uncontrolled.

असंवसन्त् a. not living together with (instr.).
असंवीत a. uncovered, unclothed.
आशान्वित a. hopeful.

असंशय m. no doubt;

असं˚श्रवे (loc.) not within hearing of (gen.).
असंसारिन् a. not subject to the mundane existence.

असंस्कार्य a. not to be adorned etc. (v. seq.).

असंस्कृत a. unadorned, uncultivated, unprepared,
uninitiated, unmarried.

अ॑संस्थित a. not standing still, restless,
inconstant.

असकल a. incomplete;
 ˚व्यक्ति a. not fully appearing.

असकृत् adv. not once;

(loc.).
असक्तात्मन् a. whose mind is not attached to (loc.).
असगोत्र a. not of the same family.

असंकसुक a. not fickle;

असंख्य a. innumerable.

अ॑संख्यात^1 a. innumerable.

2 असत्त्व n. non-existence, non-substantiality;

असत्पुत्र a. having no son.

असत्यसंध a. faithless, treacherous.
असद्भाव m. non-presence, absence.
असनाम a. not having the same name.

wicked. f. असती an unchaste woman. n. non-existence, untruth, lie.
evil.

असंतोष m. dissatisfaction.
अ॑संदित a. unbound.

असंन्यस्त a. not laid down or given up.
1 अ॑सपत्न m. no rival.

2 असपत्न॑ a. unrivalled;

असमस्त a. not compounded (g.).

असमाप्त a. unfinished.

असमुद्रोत्थित a. not risen from the ocean.
अ॑समृद्ध a. imperfect.

असंपत्ति f. want of success, failure.

असंप्राप्त^1 a. not arrived, unsuccessful;

unfulfilled (desire).
